description: This file defines custom Sphinx roles for linking to Zephyr project files and managing GitHub references, including functions for retrieving Git revision info and setting up roles with project-specific URLs.

methods.name: get_github_rev
methods.description: Retrieves the current Git revision or defaults to 'main' if not found.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures Sphinx roles and settings for linking Zephyr project files.

methods.name: modulelink
methods.description: Creates a Sphinx role for linking to module files in the repository, resolving URLs based on project manifest and configuration.
